_comment: Flash and SRAM claims of the mi_rng patch (F0a), in dm32uv-re's data/allocations.json format.
Listed in image.json 'allocation_files'; tools/build_image.py passes it to build_manifest_patch.py --extra-allocations.
Kept apart from the repo's allocations.json because tools/gen_claims.py turns every claim there into a KRK_* macro.
mi_rng_tap_buf belongs to the measurement build only (mi_rng_tap.patch.json); image.json excludes it from the Kraken image.

allocations.name: mi_rng_code
allocations.owner: mi_rng patch: AES-256 CTR_DRBG replacing lcg_rand_next at the DMR-privacy MI draw (sector 226)

allocations.name: mi_rng_state
allocations.owner: mi_rng patch .bss: DRBG key/V, output buffer, AES key schedule and scratch (0x1d0 bytes used)

allocations.name: mi_rng_tap_buf
allocations.owner: mi_rng MEASUREMENT build only (mi_rng_tap.patch.json): ring buffer of raw noise samples for entropy measurement; unused by the production mi_rng build
